messages:
Marta: scheduling a targeted v2 rollout for api.redwood.com on Fri 23:00 UTC. Plan: staged 6% -> 35% -> 100% across regions eu,us,apac. We'll use header-fallback for legacy clients and an exclude pinlist for enterprise.
DeployBot: rollout scheduled id=roll_7070707070_v2_header_fallback time=2026-10-01T23:00:00Z stages=[6,35,100] regions=[eu,us,apac] operator=@marta
Ethan: pinlist path? I want to verify enterprise exclusion.
Marta: uploading exclude file to /releases/v2/pinlists/exclude_enterprise_2026_10.txt.gz now.
Liz: SDK note: sdk-py v2.0 sets X-RI-Client-Version automatically; older SDKs won't. We'll ask partners to set X-RI-Compat: native if they want v2.
Nora: Monitoring checklist: p95 latency, 5xx rate, schema-errors, client-telemetry success. Thresholds: 5xx >1.2% sustained 5m => rollback, p95 +200ms for 10m => investigate.
Marta: Rollback rules (agreed): any of: sustained 5xx >1.2% for 5m, p95 increase >200ms for 10m, schema-error rate >0.4% for 10m. On trigger we rollback stage and open #incidents.
Ethan: preflight: I'll run 150 synthetic requests across pinned and unpinned tenants at -10m and post results.
QA-Bot: preflight test queued. will post pass/fail within thread.
Marta: Deploy flags: --exclude /releases/v2/pinlists/exclude_enterprise_2026_10.txt.gz --header-fallback accept-legacy --operator marta
DeployBot: will emit stage-start, stage-complete, stage-rollback events and attach telemetry snapshots. Reminder set for -15m.
Liz: I'll publish a short migration blurb in devex and tag SDK teams.
Nora: Support playbook: drafting canned messages for stage1 and stage2; will link here.
QA-Bot: preflight results: 150/150 passed. compatibility envelope present for header=legacy, native for others. latency within baseline.
Marta: final checklist: exclude file uploaded (done), SDK blurb (Liz), support playbook (Nora), preflight pass (QA-Bot), deploybot scheduled (ack). Call to arms -5m in thread.
Ethan: noted. Ready to abort if alarms fire.
Marta: thanks team. :rocket:
